claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellLifecycleOverride
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants access to an existing spell, but only with item-specific upkeep semantics: the granted Detect Thoughts instance does not require concentration and instead persists only while a separately granted Scrying instance remains active. The current surface can override DC and targeting, but it cannot override a granted spell's concentration requirement or tie its lifetime to another ongoing spell.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends."
